rows.grounds: object described as the Kaula essence
compound identifying the nectar; kaula + sadbhāva
compound qualifying the Kaula essence; kāmakalā + ātmaka

items.question: What essential nature characterizes the nectar identified as the Kaula true reality?
premises: The nectar is identified as the Kaula true-nature.
This Kaula true-nature is characterized as consisting of kāmakalā.
The listener is directly commanded to hear about this nectar.
items.inference: The supreme nectar of the Kaula reality is essentially constituted by kāmakalā.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal nuance of kāmakalā in this context is not fully specified within the verse.
items.plain_english: Hear of the nectar, the true nature of Kaula, which consists of Kāmakalā.
